data.body: S1 T2 (34f2) IMPLEMENTED and PUSHED: Gerrit 1883, commit 657802f827. binding_store.py 799 -> 710 LOC; persistence deleted (_load, _load_retired, _retired_entries, _save_retired, _alert, save body, _EMPTY_STORE, path construction, json/tempfile imports) and routed to the repository; every lifecycle method left verbatim. Facade ALIASES repo.data rather than copying, so peer_state/baseline/rich-text in-place writes still persist. Held-out validation: all 4 withheld discriminators PASSED unseen (shallow all_bindings copy depth, corruption-disposition parity, peer_state/get_rotation independence, repository non-exposure). Implementer took 1 attempt and correctly flagged that two imports in my visible test block were unused - a true artifact of my hold-out, since they belong to the withheld independence test - and noted the independence constraint was therefore unpinned in what it could see. MUTATION FOUND A REAL ORACLE GAP, the most valuable result of this slice: mutating self._data = self._repo.data to dict(self._repo.data) stayed GREEN across all 27 tests, because a shallow outer copy still shares the inner bindings/reverse dicts - only a NEW top-level key diverges. record_comment_id does setdefault('comment_ids') on a legacy store, so under that mutation comment identity would never reach the persisted bytes and every mirrored comment would re-post (the DIG-5301 duplicate class). Added an 8th test pinning that a top-level insert on a legacy store reaches the bytes; it now fails with KeyError: 'comment_ids' under the mutation and passes on the real code. REBASE: Gerrit rebased T1 on submit so it landed as 4758d47f82, not my local ffb1fee5ac, and main advanced to 32cd025eff; I verified zero upstream drift in binding_store.py and test_binding_store.py, confirmed the landed binding_repository.py is byte-identical to mine, then reset onto origin/main and reapplied T2 so the stack tracks real main. GATES: make lint 0, typecheck 561 files Success, 3251 passed + 9 skipped across tests/unit/rebar_reconciler + tests/interfaces/store + module-size contract, config-reads gate 0 findings.
